{{Quote|The Emperor called us here, to Section X. Once a pure Rakata construction, this security block is now riddled with Republic cells. The Dread Masters were imprisoned here. Now they're free and wage war against us. They hunt for something in Section X--something to destroy the Empire.|Commander [[Nol (human)|Nol]]|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Horror on Belsavis|Section X}}</ref>}}
'''Section X''' was the original site of the [[Belsavis prison]] colony on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Around [[3668 BBY]], a [[Fatality|ship]] containing dozens of [[HK-51 series assassin droid]]s and piloted by one of [[Dread Masters]]'s apprentices, crashed there.

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Section X appears in the [[BioWare]] developed MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a dailies area.
